title: FIPS gate missing: framework/key_export_public dispatch (ioctl_key_get_info)
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1461 — ioctl_key_get_info() calls ops->key_export_public() at line 1461 without calling ops->fips_gate() first. crypto2dev_provider.h explicitly lists key_export_public as a gated callback. The call is a trial export to determine key length — but key_export_public is still a crypto-touching operation and must be gated. No current provider implements key_export_public (all NULL), but the structural gap will affect any future provider that adds it.
